svg.aria-label: Catalog: syncom's own benchmarks. The record catalog in memory, 100k rows with two sorted indexes (chunked sorted arrays): a put keeps them up, a load or a definition builds them once, a scan seeks; a page sought after its edge and a count the index answers, over the memory engine. ops/s, log scale, higher is better.
